breakdown.description: The prompt makes the bending stress uniform through the depth, even though the flexure formula gives a linear stress distribution with zero stress at the neutral axis.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly repeats the erroneous instruction by treating bending stress as uniform over the section depth. It reports –60 MPa at the neutral axis (y = 0 mm), which directly contradicts the correct flexure formula σ = M·y/I, which yields 0 MPa at the neutral axis. The ground truth requires a linear stress distribution with zero stress at the neutral axis, –60 MPa at the top fiber (compression under sagging), and +60 MPa at the bottom fiber (tension under sagging). The agent failed to fix this inconsistency.
